content_of_post_to_comment: I used to dread Sunday nights, until I realized that on Monday it actually isn't that bad once I get into the day. Curious what you do to make your Monday seem/feel easier
comment: I’ve found that making Monday morning deliberately boring helps a lot. I’ll decide what I’m doing first, get coffee, and avoid thinking about the whole week at once. Sunday anxiety seems to come more from imagining Monday as one giant task than from what actually happens once the day starts.
